author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
How will engineers with AI agents change the company organization and incentive structure?   I spent the tokens asking ChatGPT Pro Deep Research, here is the report.

TL;DR - incentive structure from pre-AI no longer works with engineers using AI agents, bad incentives breed bad behaviors, which leads to failure.

shared_article.title: AI Junior-Engineer Agents and the Rewiring of Software Organizations
